items.text: The pistachio gelato is the real thing, and the site said the lime was back tomorrow, so we came back tomorrow.

items.text: Ordered a chocolate bomb for my dad's birthday with his name on it. They poured it at the table and the whole room watched.

items.text: The tasting of five is a lovely way to choose. We left with a box of the two we liked best.
items.author: Claire D.

questions.a: Yes. Nothing we make contains alcohol or pork gelatine, and the halal mark on the menu shows it. Ask us about any item.

questions.q: Do you have eggless and vegan desserts?
questions.a: Yes: the menu marks them, and the filter shows only those. Most cakes can be made with our eggless vanilla or vegan chocolate sponge.

questions.q: I have a nut allergy. Is anything safe?
questions.a: Many desserts don't contain nuts, and every item lists its allergens. Our kitchen handles nuts every day, so tell us when you order and we'll talk you through it.

questions.q: Can we just walk in? Is it busy?
questions.a: Yes, we don't take table bookings in the evening. The counter on the home page shows what's left right now.

questions.q: How far ahead do I need to order a cake?
questions.a: Three days, or four if you ask after 3pm. The cake page shows the earliest day we can make yours right now.

questions.q: Can you put a name or message on it?
questions.a: Yes, on a white chocolate plaque, up to 24 letters, for £4.

questions.q: Do you have space for a big group?
questions.a: Upstairs seats 18 and can be hired. See Private hire, or message us.
Yes, through Deliveroo and Uber Eats until we close. Cakes are collection only.

questions.q: How long do the chocolates keep?
questions.a: Two weeks from the day you buy them; the truffles are best within a week. Each box has its date on the ribbon.
Somewhere cool and dry, 15 to 18°C, away from sunlight. Not in the fridge: it dulls the shine and they pick up other smells.
Yes, on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays by Royal Mail Tracked 24, packed cold. Order by noon; it usually arrives the next day.
